mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low FEDFUNDS rate (< 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in UNRATE below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to expected rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO growth exceeds 1.5% YoY and HOUST is above its 6-month moving average, it signals supply chain resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO YoY growth > 1.5% and HOUST > 6-mo MA
failure_condition: Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS exceeding its 12-month moving average signals increased consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances with RSAFS above its 12-mo MA.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.25% increase in FEDFUNDS within a month signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns after rate hikes are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS growth exceeds 200,000 YoY and UNRATE is below 5%, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.04 over any 18-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL growth below 1.5% YoY signals muted inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced rate hike expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during low-inflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).
